scenes.narration: What happens to your body after six months in space?
scenes.headline: 6 MONTHS IN SPACE

scenes.narration: Day one. Your stomach has no idea which way is down. [sighs] Space sickness.
scenes.headline: DAY 1

scenes.narration: Week two. Fluid floats to your head. Puffy face, skinny bird legs.
scenes.headline: WEEK 2

scenes.narration: Month three. Your spine stretches. You are about two inches taller.
scenes.headline: MONTH 3

scenes.narration: Now you are back on Earth, and walking feels like a boss fight.
scenes.headline: THE RETURN
